title: Eagles sign RB Jaydon Blue to active roster with Jalen Hurts officially on IR

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Eagles sign RB Jaydon Blue to active roster with Jalen Hurts officially on IR
sources.description: The Eagles announced the move to place quarterback Jalen Hurts to injured reserve on Saturday afternoon and they also made a move to fill the open space on their 53-man roster.
